scope: Proposition 8.6 (A vanishing-activity shot) of the manuscript “BKT universality for height and planar spin fields” (preprints/BKT-universality-for-height-and-planar-spin-fields-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e6a8df09e021c4a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 132. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In each of the following regimes there is a choice of the input s in Equation (8.2) for which all interaction activities tend to zero exponentially in scale: (i) J = Jρ, a prescribed fixed a′ > k0, and ρ sufficiently large; (ii) an arbitrary fixed admissible J and a′ sufficiently large. The shot satisfies |s| ≤ Cx∗, where x∗ is exponentially small in a′v2 in (i), and x∗ ≤ CJ e−cJ a′ in (ii). At the input k = a′/(1 − s) its actual structural coefficient is exactly a′.
